description: This header file declares the class LibMediaPlayerImpl which implements MediaPlayer APIs for media playback management, including mediation with libmediaplayer and CAS services within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: LibMediaPlayerImpl
classes.description: Implements MediaPlayer APIs to support media playback functionalities using libmediaplayer and CAS services.

methods.name: openMediaPlayer
methods.description: Initializes libmediaplayer with environment variables and registers callback methods.

methods.name: eventCallBack
methods.description: Static callback to register with mediaplayer to receive status notifications.

methods.name: errorCallBack
methods.description: Static callback to register with mediaplayer to receive error notifications.
